text: Lion... or fox? Which one are you?
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Picture Sam. Fearless. A pure lion.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: He signs a big deal fast... and walks into a trap in the small print.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Maya is a pure fox. She spots every trap... but when a bully pushes, she folds.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Machiavelli wrote... it is necessary to be a fox to discover the snares... and a lion to terrify the wolves.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: His fox also breaks promises... a great pretender and dissembler.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Don't copy that. Understand it... so nobody plays you. Spot the trap... never set one.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Your action today: before you say yes to anything, ask one fox question... what's the catch? Then answer like a lion.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: More lion, or more fox? Comment below.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Follow Awaaz for your daily mindset.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural
